reviews.text: I’m very pleased with Aqua Clean Pool Service.  We took care of our pool, ourselves, for 28 years and always fought the algae, often going through an enormous amount of chemicals and days of brushing.  Since Dillan started taking care of our pool two years ago, our pool has stayed blue consistently with far less chemicals.  He does an amazing job maintaining the water chemistry.  He is a very nice and courteous young man and always has a great attitude, even when he has to battle the extreme temperatures.  Scott, the owner, is very professional and quick to respond to issues.  Our pool seemed to have a leak and we feared having to go through a leak detection process.  I called Aqua Clean and Scott came an hour later and replaced the backwash o-ring and the problem is fixed.  So appreciative of his quick response and knowledge of pool systems.  A year ago he recommended we replace our pump and filter and we immediately saw a reduction in our electric bill and improvement in water quality.  Josh, the technician has done several repairs and installed the pump and filter and did a great job.  Gail, Scott’s mom who handles the office, is always very kind and concerned and quick to handle any issue we might have.  Thank you Scott, Dillan, Josh, and Gail for taking such good care of us!
reviews.author: Cyndi Stevens

reviews.text:
Recent Update: after refilling my pool with tap water following a leak fix, I forgot to immediately backwash pool filter and caused some D.E. slurry to be in my pool before I can balance the water chemistry. Josh came to clean the filter and Scott came to balance the water chemistry while cleaning the pool. Two procedures were completed in one day, resulting time saving and reduced hassle in my end. I was happy to see my pool coming back clean in just two days. For their rapid response and wonderful services, I now call them "pool rescuer".
Initial Service Experience: The backwash valve of my pool filter got worn out recently and cannot be opened for backwash anymore. I called Aqua Clean Pool Service and was initially told I won't get an appointment till 4 to 5 days later. But office manager Gail worked her magic and got me a spot the same day from owner Scott. He did a very good job to fix the problem and told me the areas to watch for during routine pool operations in the future. He always sounded friendly and courteous in our conversation. I will definitely keep this company in mind for my future pool maintenance needs.
Update: Josh came one week later to clean my pool filter and he did a thorough cleaning of the clogged filter. Now my pool water circulates much better and pool becomes clean faster.
reviews.author: Jun Li

reviews.text: For around 20 years, we owned a house with a pool. During the final decade or so, we used Aqua Clean as our pool service.  Scott and crew would maintain our pool while we were away, do filter cleanings, and do repairs.  We were highly satisfied with their work!
reviews.author: Brian McClung

reviews.text: Aqua Clean Pool Service (Scott & team) are very courteous, highly professional and knowledgeable. Excellent quality pool cleaning and repair services. Responses and service is prompt and fast.
reviews.author: Abdul Hadi Pasha

reviews.text: I highly recommend Aqua Clean Pool Service because they have completely outperformed all other pool services we've had here in Frisco for the last 13 years. The pool has never looked better!!!  Thank you!!
reviews.author: K Donovan

reviews.text: Pool filter was in desperate need of being replaced. Josh, Dillon, and the team brought my pool back to life. My pool has never looked more amazing since having Aqua Clean take care of it.
reviews.author: aaron mueller

reviews.text: After purchasing a home, we encountered some issues where the pool needed to be cleaned. I contacted Aqua Clean after another company repeatedly kept rescheduling and made no effort to service our pool. I explained the situation to Scott, and he was able to come inspect the pool the following week. After a deep clean, the pool looked great! Scott and his team are very professional and responsive whenever questions come up. I really appreciate that they are able to perform any needed work quickly and constantly provide updates. Aqua Clean is an excellent company, and I cannot recommend them enough. They will listen to you and provide a course of action that addresses any and all needs effectively.
reviews.author: Carlos Rendon

reviews.text: I am exceptionally satisfied with Aqua Clean’s pool services. They have consistently demonstrated promptness and professionalism throughout the entire process. The pool has never appeared more pristine, and all of my equipment concerns have been resolved at a fair and reasonable cost.
reviews.author: Steven Jenks

reviews.text: I was referred to this company after purchasing a home with a pool.  Scott came out & inspected the pool, gave me a quote for both service & repairs needed to get up to speed.  He rebuilt my Polaris and charged very little to do so.  His tech (Josh) came out and rebuilt my valves (5) & added a new chlorinator.  Our weekly pool cleaner was set up & did a great job ensuring we are ready for a fun summer!!  I highly recommend Aqua Clean Pool Service!  Their team is punctual, straightforward, & offer a great service/value to their customers.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Sanborn

reviews.text: These guys are the best. I've used them for service, and regular cleanings. They are kind, professional, and very reasonable. Give them a try.
reviews.author: John Schrampfer

reviews.text: Very responsive to my pool equipment issue. Had me scheduled for repair the next day.  Josh communicated with me throughout the process and answered all of my questions.
reviews.author: David Altom

reviews.text:
I recently faced a frustrating journey with my pool pump leaking water. After reaching out to numerous companies with little to no response, I finally found one that answered my call and responded to my request the same day. Josh, the technician who assisted me, was incredibly knowledgeable and provided excellent service.

Josh not only saved me money by advising against replacing my pump, which I hadn't used, but also went above and beyond by checking my pool robot. When he found out I didn't use the pump for the robot, he decided to redo the piping and fixed everything like magic.

Despite a minor issue with the payment process, I am very satisfied with the service and especially appreciative of Josh's expertise. I will definitely use their services again, thanks to Josh's outstanding work.
reviews.author: Justin

reviews.text: Scott and the Aqua Clean Pool Service Team - Best Period !  I shopped many pool services after the last 2 I had did not do a good job.  I watched them on my cameras and for the weekly charges -vs- actually working we let them go.  Scott's team includes his awesome Mom that is always making sure we are OK.  Great Rates, Better Services.  Last Freeze from broke my pump, boom fixed asap.
reviews.author: Danny Cantrell

reviews.text: Aqua Clean has provided weekly cleaning for my pool for almost 4 years.  I travel a lot and they keep my pool looking and working wonderfully.  One of the reasons I like Aqua Clean is they have great people on staff.  The owner, Scott, is very knowledgeable and will actually return phone calls if he misses you.  If you call for service you will probably get Gail on the phone.  Gail is not only absolutely delightful but extremely competent.  When we had the bad freeze a couple of years ago and everyone's equipment froze and broke, Gail was able to get me a new pump weeks before my neighbors got theirs.  I was the envy of the neighborhood. It was truly amazing.  Another person I have to mention is Eric who has actually cleaned my pool for the past 4 years.  He is a remarkable young man who does his job dependably, efficiently, and competently.  I trust him completely with taking care of what needs taking care of.  If you are looking for an excellent pool service that is super easy to work with you should talk to Aqua Clean.
reviews.author: Jerry Johnson

reviews.text: Scott first came out on a Saturday when my pool had not been running for three days and the water was an ugly green. He quickly made some recommendations for electrical work before addressing the pump issue, as my pool and equipment date back to the mid-1980s. Scott explained about the money I would save if I opted for newer technology, but I was really sold when he said how much quieter it could be. He made it happen quickly and trained us on the new features, patiently answering all our questions. I couldn't be more pleased with his work and I highly recommend his services. 5 stars! Thank you, Scott.
reviews.author: Marilyn Wilson

reviews.text: Scott and his crew have serviced our pool now for over 2 years and we could not be happier with their honest and reliable service. They take the time to really analyze and diagnose any issues, which is greatly appreciated. Our pool runs great now! Thank you, Aqua Clean!
reviews.author: Teresa M.

reviews.text:
The only reason they're getting two stars is because of the employee that came out. Very knowledgeable and friendly.

We called and asked for a quote on monthly pool services and also a quote on heater replacement. The day before they came out we canceled the quote on the heater replacement because they were charging us for a service call. The gentleman still came out to give us a quote and they still charged us for a service call. Felt a little bit scammy.
reviews.author: Nate Coffin

reviews.text: Scott was very helpful. We needed to have our pool heater replaced. He quoted us a very competitive rate and was able to install it the next day. We were pleased with the professionalism and timely response. We have used Aqua Clean before for other repairs and every time have been happy with the results. I definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: Janet Hann

reviews.text: Scott was super helpful and took the time to talk me through navigating our pool equipment in the freeze and fixing our issue within hours!!!! Thanks for potentially saving us some costly repairs and such quick service.! Also, Gail their office assistant is also so friendly to deal with.
reviews.author: anna pecino

reviews.text: Scott has helped us with our pool for almost 10 years.  He is excellent at his work and is so helpful when there is a problem.  Several times he has come out within a day of notice and fixed issues right away, and he assures that our pool is always running smoothly and crystal clean so all we have to worry about is enjoying the sparkling waters :).  I would highly recommend Aqua Clean to anyone who wants worry-free pool maintenance.
reviews.author: Cori Sices

reviews.text:
Scott and his team at Aqua Clean were outstanding! After the arctic freeze in February I couldn't find a pool repair service to come out and repair the damage to my pool equipment. Scott made the time and kept me up-to-date  each step of the way. The repairs were made and the pool never ran better. I highly recommend you chose Aqua Clean Pool Service.

Karl Melton
Murphy, TX
reviews.author: Karl Melton

reviews.text:
Live in Plano, and can't say enough good about Aqua Clean! They have COMPLETELY turned our pool around in a mere couple of months - after a full 2 years of the previous company we used making little progress with algae issues and never managing to get our vacuum to keep from toppling on it's side and doing absolutely nothing but wasting booster pump electricity.

The Polaris vacuum finally does it's job and actually moves all over the pool, and not exaggerating, there isn't a single speck of algae left in our entire pool, and we had SEVERE black and green algae.

Scott and his team are pool/pool equipment magicians, and Gail provides the best customer service you could ever ask for. Somebody always answers the phone, and on the rare occasion they don't, you can count on them calling you back within a couple of minutes.

Their customer portal is also a very neat tool, and allows you to see in real time exactly what they have added to your pool after each visit, and also notifies you of potential equipment service recommendations.

Thank y'all very much for everything you have done and continue to do.
reviews.author: Chance Studdard

reviews.text: After my pool service shut for over a week for the holidays, during a serious freeze leaving no emergency assistance, I was very lucky to find this company for emergency help when our pool equipment stopped functioning and the pool had to be shut down. Josh, a technician, talked us through how to drain our pipes at 9PM to keep them from freezing although we had no prior relationship with the company. After that he came out, diagnosed the problem and completed the repair with professionalism and efficiency. He even assisted with a few additional issues that my pool company had not been able to figure out.  I can highly recommend Aqua Clean.
reviews.author: Diane Warden

reviews.text: I have been using this company for many years and they do a great job. I don't have to wonder whether the job will be done every week and if it will be done right. I definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Daniel Piche

reviews.text: Scott and the whole team at Aqua Clean Pool Service provide top-notch service.  You can rely on them for all your pool needs.. from cleanings, repairs and maintenance.   We highly recommend Aqua Clean Pool.
reviews.author: Lisa Tatarsky Kouzoukas

reviews.text: Great service. Needed pool equipment repairs. Scott came out Saturday morning and his crew installed two new pumps Sunday afternoon. I also am having him do my weekly cleaning and maintenance. 100% recommend this company.
reviews.author: Ladd Gibke

reviews.text: We’ve had several pool companies service our pool over the years but Aqua Clean has by far been the most trustworthy and attentive. If you’re looking for a pool company with a great weekly service team and an expert technician for the times when a fix of some sort is needed, look no further. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tonya Guillamun

reviews.text: It was New Year's Day morning when I noticed that water was no longer circulating in our pool after a freezing temperature of 18 degrees overnight.  I checked the weather and there wouldn't be a break in the cold snap for 2 days.  I knew that many plastic pipes were at risk for ice damage. I started calling around to local pool repair companies with no luck, not surprising for a holiday.  I finally called Aquaclean and Scott answered the phone.  While he wasn't providing service that day, he spent more than 20 minutes on the phone answering my questions and allaying my fears about broken pipes. He said he would come by the next morning to take a look.  He arrived promptly and went to work. I was hoping for at least some advise about how to minimize the ice damage, because I was sure he wouldn't get the pump operational.  But after about an hour after repairing a valve and servicing the frozen pump motor, he had the system working.  I told him he was a magician.  Overall I was extremely satisfied with Scott's work, professionalism, and reasonable pricing.  I am sure that will have him back for some other work and perhaps use Aquaclean for pool maintenance. I highly recommend Scott.
reviews.author: Kevin G

reviews.text: I contacted Scott two weeks ago and requested a bid to service my pool.  Scott told me that he would get out to see my pool the next day and email me a quote.  He must’ve forgotten. I called him a week later and again he told me he would be out the next day. He forgot a second time. I gave him one more chance, called him a third time and He emailed me a proposal. The proposal was unlike any I had seen in the past 20 years of being a pool owner. His prices were vague and unclear.  When I called to request information on the proposal he tried to sell me  $1500 worth of equipment  but did not have time to spend 10 minutes on the phone with me explaining his process. This is the fourth time this man had cut me off on the phone, not having time to discuss his service with me a potential client. He was rude and dismissive, and I’m so glad  he showed me exactly who he was before I gave him any money.
reviews.author: Sarah Abraham

reviews.text:
I had an actuator go out over the holidays, and with a freeze coming, it was important to me to get it fixed quickly.  I called my 'warranty guy', who didn't return my call for 3 days.  Then I called my weekly pool cleaning company, who said they'd come out and do the repair, but would charge me a $95 trip fee, in addition to the parts and labor.  I decided to try Aqua Clean, who came out the next day, made the repair, and did it at a fair price.

I'll use them for my future pool repair needs.
reviews.author: Robert Soto

reviews.text:
Scott responded quickly, provided quality work, and expert advise. I am very satisfied with the results.
My pool had poor water circulation, loss of water, was and very dirty. After Scott made repairs, the pool water looks cleaner than it has in two years. Many thanks.
reviews.author: Nancy Wyatt

reviews.text: Scott came over on short notice to take a look at my pool after I got DE all over the bottom. He fixed a problem with the filter and now, one day and one good vacuum later, the pool is so much cleaner. I'm confident that with one more vacuum, it will be 100% back to normal. Scott will now be our go-to technician when we have issues with our new pool!
reviews.author: Catherine Zercher

reviews.text: They were not only able to get me scheduled on short notice but they did an incredible job for a great price.  You actually get to speak to someone when you call and they treat you extremely well unlike larger pool companies which treat you more like a number and aren't even local to the area.  Needless to say they've won my business moving forward for all of my pool service.
reviews.author: Matt Gregg

reviews.text: We had an issue with our pool on a weekend during a freeze.  I had a hard time finding a pool service company to come out on a weekend, but Scott was willing to come out and figure out what the problem was with our pool.  He came and accessed the problem right away and went out of his way to help us with other issues.  Great company and great owner.  Truly cares about his customers.
reviews.author: Aarthi Samuel

reviews.text: Beautiful clear crystal pool, but we were overcharged 80% more than agreed upon. Also, if you have pool products that you paid for that Scott doesn't approve, he will remove it from your property and will not give it back upon request. If you do chose this business, I recommend you request an estimate of all costs beforehand and beware that if your pool supplies do not meet Scott's standards they will be taken.
reviews.author: Paul Family

reviews.text: Scott has serviced my pool for many years. He keeps my pool in in tip top shape. He always keeps me informed and he's very reasonably priced.
reviews.author: steve jong

reviews.text: Had a terrible service prior to Aqua Clean and what a difference it makes to not have something going wrong all the time like it did before.  The pool is clean, well maintained and serviced weekly without a hitch.  Great service and great customer satisfaction.  Thank you Aqua Clean for changing my view on weekly services.  You guys are great.
reviews.author: Kevin Donovan

reviews.text: Incompetent service. Called them for a service call about a burst pipe inside a heater after the freeze. The technician they sent told me that he does not have any experience with pool heaters and would not even look at the heater. He offered me to sell me a new heater for close to $2K. $90 wasted for nothing. Opened the heater myself, did my research, ordered parts and fixed it myself. All for less than $150. Will not use that company again.
reviews.author: Recumb Rider

reviews.text: I am just amazed at how beautiful my pool looks! I was out of the state and my house was on the market and needed somebody to take care of my pool until the house sold. Within hours of calling, they were at my house and started their magic. Absolutely awesome service and the price is right! You will not be disappointed if you use their services.
reviews.author: Jason Thomas

reviews.text: Aqua Clean is reliable and honest. They do great work even as finding and training pool cleaning employees has got to be a challenge.
reviews.author: Mike Efting

reviews.text: On time. Knows their stuff. Reasonably priced. It's all good!
reviews.author: Virginia Cochran

reviews.text: I have used Scott and Aqua Clean for over 6 years.  They perform amazing service for my pool and help with repairs as well.  I highly recommend Aqua Clean to anyone that wants a crystal clear pool.
reviews.author: Erik Habel

reviews.text: Scott is a very capable pool expert. After a long diagnosis he located and repaired my Polaris pool cleaner. It works perfectly now. Thanks to Scott.
reviews.author: Thomas LaPLante

reviews.text: New to the Dallas area and a new homeowner with a pool and spa. The one good thing I'll say is that Scott got his phone on a Sunday other than that, this guy was just plain rude. I am in sales and he basically wanted me to commit to spending over $100 for a simple stop by. When I tried to explain my situation to him, he hung up on me. Stay away from this angry person!
reviews.author: AJ Costantini

reviews.text: Scott and his team are as reliable, fair priced and honest as it gets. Been with them for over 8 years and I’ve never had an issue. Highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Fabio Fernandez

reviews.text: Great service and knowledgeable crew! Often has extra parts on hand to fix pool cleaner and has helped diagnose issues with my equipment. Would recommend to anyone needing reliable pool service!
reviews.author: Nicole Dortona

reviews.text: Really appreciate the professional service from Scott.  He is knowledgeable and personable.  I got the pool pump and motor issues fixed thanks to his excellent work during the memorial weekend.
reviews.author: John Lin

reviews.text:
It took me years to finally find a professional, reliable pool service.
They are absolutely the very best!
